global_flags.name: json
global_flags.usage: Write JSON. This is the default when output is not a terminal.

commands.name: call
commands.summary: Call any Smrit tool: smrit call <tool> [--arg name=value] [--json-args '{...}'].

flags.name: org
flags.usage: The organization to use, when signed in to several.

flags.name: arg
flags.usage: A tool argument as name=value. Repeat it. JSON values are sent as JSON.

flags.name: json-args
flags.usage: The tool arguments as one JSON object; each --arg overrides it.

commands.name: import
commands.summary: Import a plan into Smrit, or preview it with --dry-run, which writes nothing.

flags.name: org
flags.usage: The organization to use, when signed in to several.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.usage: Preview what the plan would do. Nothing is written.

flags.name: resume
flags.usage: Carry on the run with this id, skipping what it already imported.

flags.name: org
flags.usage: The organization to use, when signed in to several.

commands.name: logout
commands.summary: Sign out and forget the sign in on this machine.

flags.name: org
flags.usage: The organization to use, when signed in to several.

commands.name: retire
commands.summary: Remove the files a finished import moved into Smrit, zipping any git cannot restore. Without --apply it only reports: smrit retire <run> [--apply]

flags.name: apply
flags.usage: Remove the files. Without it nothing is touched.

commands.name: scan
commands.summary: List the files in folders with their git state, links and flags, never their contents: smrit scan <path>...

commands.name: setup
commands.summary: Connect a harness to Smrit: smrit setup <harness>. Shows the exact changes; --apply makes them.

flags.name: org
flags.usage: The organization to use, when signed in to several.

flags.name: apply
flags.usage: Make the changes. Without it setup only shows them.

flags.name: block
flags.usage: Where the always on block goes: everywhere, project or both.

flags.name: project
flags.usage: The project folder for the project file. The default is the top of the current git repository.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Show who you are signed in as and what you can see.

flags.name: org
flags.usage: The organization to use, when signed in to several.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.summary: Replace this smrit with the latest release, verified against its checksum. A copy a package manager installed is left to that package manager.

flags.name: check
flags.usage: Only report the latest version and this one. Nothing is downloaded.

exit_codes.meaning: The command did what was asked.
The command ran but some items failed or were skipped.
The command line was wrong: an unknown command or flag, or a missing argument.
There is no usable sign in; run smrit login.
The request was refused: by the server, for example because of permissions or limits, or by smrit, for example a folder scan will not read, or an import plan in which every entry is refused.
The server could not be reached or failed; try again later.
This version of smrit is too old for the server; install a newer release.
